blockingIssues: In Atom DRYRUN_JEE_MAIN_2026_CHEMISTRY_JEE_MAIN_2026_CHEM_U19_T_69EF29B0_CH001, the specific optical rotation of the invert sugar mixture is incorrectly stated as '-39.7 degrees'. The actual specific rotation is the mass-weighted average of D-glucose (+52.7) and D-fructose (-92.4), which is approximately -19.85 degrees. Stating -39.7 degrees incorrectly implies simple addition and contradicts the [alpha]_D(net) formula correctly provided in the same atom's formula register.
review.reviewNotes: The majority of the atoms demonstrate high-quality instruction with accurate concepts, reliable worked examples, and precise formulas tailored for the JEE Main syllabus. Atom DRYRUN_JEE_MAIN_2026_CHEMISTRY_JEE_MAIN_2026_CHEM_U19_T_69EF29B0_CH001 was flagged because the specific rotation value for invert sugar represents a common misconception that needs correction (averaging rather than adding the specific rotations). Atom CH002 on the same topic correctly calculates this value as -19.85 degrees, establishing inconsistency. Once CH001 is fixed, the entire DigiBook is good to go.
